guide.title: How to Enable in Game
guide.step1: Create a new mod folder in Documents/Paradox Interactive/Stellaris/mod, and create descriptor.mod inside it;
guide.step2: Copy the entire localisation folder from the output directory into your new mod folder;
guide.step3: Enable the mod in the Stellaris Launcher playset and drag it to the VERY BOTTOM of the load order.
guide.importantNote: IMPORTANT: Place this mod at the very bottom of the load order, otherwise texts will be overridden by other mods.
